purpose: Canonical experiment-state registry: local/global purpose, exact arms, mechanisms present/absent, execution status, falsification scope, outcome, source pointers, and dependency flow.

time_policy.new_records: Use RFC3339 UTC seconds when verified.
time_policy.historical_backfill: Never invent clock time; use date_only until artifact/commit verifies it.
time_policy.display_timezone: UTC canonical; Europe/Istanbul may be shown additionally.

records.local_question: Can the historical latent-only family fit/retain Mage?
records.global_purpose: Establish same-witness capacity without structural-AR/generalization claims.
records.outcome_summary: Historical strong same-witness capacity/retention evidence exists; exact result pointer still requires bootstrap normalization.
survived_or_supported: latent-only family has substantial Mage FIT1 capacity
records.target_effect: Moved diagnosis from raw capacity toward conditioning/stability.
records.necessity_assessment: Useful historical capacity witness; not architecture closure.

records.local_question: Does a lossless fixed-8-view evidence side path improve reachability/stability?
records.global_purpose: Repair lossy evidence contract before attributing failure to later mechanisms.
records.outcome_summary: Lossless evidence repaired the representation boundary and achieved reachability but not terminal stability alone.
falsified_or_weakened: summary-only raster evidence is sufficient generic product authority
records.target_effect: Moved bottleneck toward evidence access and stability.

records.local_question: Does per-step access to full lossless surface memory improve reachability/retention?
records.global_purpose: Isolate evidence access before changing locus or causal skeleton state.
records.outcome_summary: Full-surface access improved fit/reachability behavior but did not close terminal long-horizon stability.
falsified_or_weakened: evidence access alone explains all terminal instability
survived_or_supported: full-surface access is useful generic evidence mechanism

records.local_question: On corrected-raster conditioning, which minimal rung first yields the preregistered stable fit: R2 baseline, C1 full-surface xattn, or if necessary C2 diffusion?
records.global_purpose: Causally isolate RigAnything-inspired evidence/locus mechanisms via a staircase rather than bundle changes.
arms: C2: xattn ON/diffusion ON/feedback OFF — only if C1 failed
records.outcome_summary: R2 stable FAIL; C1 stable PASS; preregistered staircase stopped and C2 was not executed. Winner candidate C1. Causal interpretation: XATTN_RESCUES_THIS_FROZEN_TRAINING_PROTOCOL__NOT_THEORETICAL_NECESSITY.
falsified_or_weakened: R2 corrected-raster baseline alone closes this frozen protocol
survived_or_supported: per-step full-surface xattn causally rescues this frozen Mage training protocol relative to R2
records.target_effect: Established controlled C1 evidence and, by staircase design, intentionally left C2 untested.
records.necessity_assessment: High-value component closure because it preserves causal attribution.

records.local_question: What changes when conditional diffusion is added on top of C1 full-surface access?
records.global_purpose: Separate locus-generation mechanism from skeleton feedback.
records.outcome_summary: C2 was implemented and preregistered as the third Causal Repair V2 staircase rung, but C1 passed and the staircase stopped. The authoritative Drive runs folder contains only R2 and C1 results. Therefore no C2 result is authorized from that experiment.
survived_or_supported: diffusion remains independently testable if later scientifically necessary
records.target_effect: Preserved an untested mechanism option without contaminating the C1 causal result.
records.necessity_assessment: Implementation lineage only until a future prereg actually executes it.

records.local_question: Does preregistered strong-trunk actual-update containment prevent catastrophic Mage retention failures?
records.global_purpose: Separate optimizer runaway from forward-architecture defects.
records.outcome_summary: Containment strongly reduced catastrophic failures, but strict preregistered terminal closure did not pass; no post-hoc promotion.
falsified_or_weakened: all Mage retention failures must be forward-architecture failures
survived_or_supported: optimizer-time trunk runaway has causal role on Mage
records.necessity_assessment: Useful FIT1 diagnostic/containment, not generic architecture answer.
records.index_note: Exact result pointer still requires bootstrap normalization.

records.local_question: How does the fuller full-surface+diffusion+joint/parent feedback+order-handling formulation behave?
records.global_purpose: Preserve full clean-room formulation lineage while components are isolated.
records.outcome_summary: Executable research challenger exists; no authoritative C3/C4 closed result is registered.
survived_or_supported: fuller RigAnything mechanism family already translated into RealSaS research source
records.target_effect: Prevents repeated reimplementation and preserves formulation-level option.
records.necessity_assessment: Run only if dependency graph makes it necessary.

records.local_question: Does minimal joint+parent mechanical recurrent feedback improve matched Mage FIT1 reachability/retention?
records.global_purpose: Isolate generated-skeleton causal state from the fuller RigAnything bundle.
records.outcome_summary: Both arms completed 16384 and failed terminal 48-check stability. Verdict AR01_NO_TERMINAL_CLOSURE. AR0 max exact streak 61 but terminal streak 1; AR1 no free-running structural PASS despite exact teacher-forced final state.
falsified_or_weakened: exact minimal AR-01 feedback implementation is terminal FIT1 repair
one earlier stable streak is sufficient terminal evidence
records.target_effect: Closed minimal-feedback ambiguity and partitioned remaining questions.

records.local_question: Which single uncertainty is next: AR0 terminal stability, AR1 generated-state exposure/recovery, or fuller C3/C4 formulation?
records.global_purpose: Prevent bundled post-hoc repair and choose one falsifiable next gate.
records.outcome_summary: OPEN DECISION STATE; no new scientific run is preregistered.
cannot_prove: any mechanism is superior before new prereg
records.target_effect: Keeps Geppetto moving toward refreeze without uncontrolled bundling.

records.local_question: Which Geppetto mechanism set is justified after required post-AR01 gates?
records.global_purpose: Freeze a generic/generalization-oriented Geppetto before Arachne.
records.target_effect: Unlocks Arachne only after genuine refreeze.

records.local_question: Can Arachne learn editable skin/weight/deformation from qualified IRIS+Geppetto outputs with SkinTokens clean-room audit?
records.global_purpose: Close deformation layer for an actual editable 2D puppet.
records.necessity_assessment: Next major product-science module after Geppetto.

records.local_question: Can compiled Mage show convincing qualified idle/breath motion with editable rig/deformation and preserved 2D appearance?
records.global_purpose: First emotionally legible RealSaS product proof.
